messages.author: afa289b81aad98c2
messages.subject: Function Problem During Check, not in Console
parts:
This will probably be a bit much for people to digest, but hopefully someone can see the problem.  I have a function, compareCats, which is appended below.  Also appended below is the example from the corresponding Rd file.  After building this into a package to update for R 2.14, I find that the example executes fine if copied into the console.  However, when running the package check, the same example fails, with error message shown below.

I'm sorry this is so darn long, and you won't be able to run it unless you ask me for the entire package.  So I'm hoping someone can browse it and see the problem.  I don't want to waste your time.

Thanks so much.  Bryan
***********
Bryan Hanson
Professor of Chemistry & Biochemistry
DePauw University

******* Error thrown by checking packages

* checking examples ... ERROR
Running examples in ‘HandyStuff-Ex.R’ failed
The error most likely occurred in:

> ### Name: compareCats
> ### Title: Compare Data by Category
> ### Aliases: compareCats
> ### Keywords: graphics
> 
> ### ** Examples
> 
> df <- data.frame(
+ resp = rnorm(40),
+ cat1 = sample(LETTERS[1:3], 40, replace = TRUE),
+ cat2 = sample(letters[1:2], 40, replace = TRUE))
> #
> p <- compareCats(data = df, res = "resp", fac1 = "cat1",
+ fac2 = "cat2", method = "iqr", freckles = TRUE,
+ fac1cols = c("red", "green", "blue"))
Error in structure(list(data = data, layers = list(), scales = Scales$new(),  : 
  attempt to apply non-function
Calls: compareCats -> ggplot -> ggplot.data.frame -> structure
Execution halted

****** Function compareCats

compareCats <-
function(data = NULL, res = NULL,
fac1 = NULL, fac2 = NULL,
fac1cols = NULL, freckles = FALSE,
method = c("sem", "iqr", "mad", "box", "points", "sem95"),
xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL, title = NULL, ...)
{

# Function to compare categorical data by
# plotting means and se's or something similar
# Bryan Hanson, DePauw Univ, Jan 2010


if (is.null(fac1cols)) stop("You need to supply fac1cols")


# 1st, reduce the df and clean it of NAs
# otherwise there is trouble with the counts


if (!identical(fac2, NULL)) {
keep <- c(res, fac1, fac2)
} else {
keep <- c(res, fac1)
}
data <- data[, keep]
data <- na.omit(data)

# Specify the data & aesthetics


if (identical(fac2, NULL)) { 
p <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = fac1, y = res, color = fac1))


} else {
p <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = fac1, y = res, color = fac1)) +
facet_grid(paste(". ~", fac2, sep = ""))
}


# now add layers as requested


if (freckles) {
if (method == "points") stop("It doesn't make sense to combine points with freckles!")
jit <- position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0.0)
p <- p + layer(geom = "jitter", position = jit, color = "black", size = 1) 
}

if (method == "points") {
jit <- position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0.0)
p <- p + layer(geom = "jitter", position = jit) }


if (method == "box") {
p <- p + geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = 2)
}


if (method == "sem") {
p <- p + stat_summary(fun.data = "seXy") }


if (method == "sem95") {
p <- p + stat_summary(fun.data = "seXy95")
}

if (method == "mad") {
p <- p + stat_summary(fun.data = "seXyMad")
}


if (method == "iqr") {
p <- p + stat_summary(fun.data = "seXyIqr")
}

# now add the common decorations & modifications


p <- p  + scale_colour_manual(values = fac1cols) +
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(colour = "black"),
axis.text.x = theme_text(colour = "black"),
axis.ticks = theme_blank(), legend.position = "none", ...)


# now add labels and fix limits (modified from qplot)


    if (!is.null(title)) p <- p + opts(title = title)
    if (!is.null(xlab)) p <- p + xlab(xlab)
    if (!is.null(ylab)) p <- p + ylab(ylab)
#    if (exists("xlim")) p <- p + xlim(xlim)
#    if (exists("ylim")) p <- p + ylim(ylim)



p <- p + geom_text(aes_string(x = fac1,
y = paste("min(",res,") - 0.1 * diff(range(",res,"))", sep=""),
label = 'paste("n = ", ..count.. , sep = "")'),
color = "black", size = 4.0, stat = "bin", data = data)

invisible(p)
}

****** Example that works in console, not during checking

df <- data.frame(
resp = rnorm(40),
cat1 = sample(LETTERS[1:3], 40, replace = TRUE),
cat2 = sample(letters[1:2], 40, replace = TRUE))
#
p <- compareCats(data = df, res = "resp", fac1 = "cat1",
fac2 = "cat2", method = "iqr", freckles = TRUE,
fac1cols = c("red", "green", "blue"))
print(p)

OK, replying to my own inquiry, it looks to me that this *may* have
something to do with a function name conflict. Specifically, if I do
> conflicts(detail = TRUE) I see that ggplot2 has a function called
Position as does base R. Since my function calls position_jitter I
suspect that my function may indirectly try to call ggplot2::Position
and finds instead base::Position. I don't know why this should be
true, since ggplot2 is clearly loaded after the base, but I have no
better explanation.

This is a new problem with R 2.14. The package which has this problem
has the following NAMESPACE statement:

import(RColorBrewer, MASS, plyr, grid, ChemoSpec, gsubfn, gridExtra,
ggplot2, ggExtra)

Is my explanation believable? Is there a solution? Thanks, Bryan
